deffuant.scientific_rationale: A larger confidence bound increases accepted encounters, which intensifies local assimilation and reduces neighborhood opinion heterogeneity, ultimately lowering global opinion variance.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: More accepted interactions shrink opinion differences between connected agents, decreasing within-neighborhood opinion standard deviation; lower neighborhood dispersion then translates into lower whole-system opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under plus confidence_bound is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: A smaller confidence bound reduces accepted interactions, leaving more local opinion differences unresolved and increasing neighborhood variance, which then raises global opinion variance.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Fewer accepted encounters weaken local assimilation, so opinion variance within neighborhoods increases; greater local variance contributes directly to higher whole-system opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under minus confidence_bound is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: A larger confidence bound increases accepted encounters, which reduces the variance of sampled interaction distances and supports a larger connected component.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: More accepted interactions make local sampled opinion distances more uniform, reducing neighborhood interaction distance variance; lower distance variance decreases disruptive rewiring and helps preserve a larger largest component.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_largest_component_fraction under plus confidence_bound is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: A smaller confidence bound reduces accepted encounters, increasing sampled interaction distance heterogeneity and weakening global network connectivity.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Fewer accepted interactions leave more variable opinion distances in neighborhoods, raising neighborhood interaction distance standard deviation; greater local distance variability can fragment the network, reducing the largest component fraction.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_largest_component_fraction under minus confidence_bound is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: A larger confidence bound increases accepted interactions, reducing local absolute opinion dispersion and, under the initial distribution, lowering the global mean opinion.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: More accepted encounters homogenize absolute opinion values within neighborhoods, lowering neighborhood absolute opinion standard deviation; this decreased dispersion shifts the whole-system mean opinion downward relative to baseline.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_mean under plus confidence_bound is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: A smaller confidence bound reduces accepted encounters, increasing local absolute opinion variance and reducing opinion assortativity.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Fewer accepted interactions leave more absolute opinion heterogeneity inside neighborhoods, raising neighborhood absolute opinion variance; higher local variance weakens opinion similarity along edges, decreasing network assortativity.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_assortativity under minus confidence_bound is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Higher assimilation strength increases opinion shift magnitudes, accelerating local convergence and lowering both neighborhood and global opinion variance.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Larger accepted updates pull connected opinions closer more quickly, reducing within-neighborhood opinion standard deviation; lower neighborhood dispersion reduces whole-system opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under plus assimilation_strength is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lower assimilation strength reduces opinion shift magnitudes, preserving local opinion differences and increasing global variance.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Smaller updates leave opinion gaps within neighborhoods less resolved, increasing neighborhood opinion variance; this local dispersion raises whole-system opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under minus assimilation_strength is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Higher assimilation strength increases shift magnitudes and their variability, which under the initial opinion distribution raises the global mean.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Larger and more variable opinion shifts increase neighborhood agent shift standard deviation; this heightened local displacement moves the whole-system mean opinion upward relative to baseline.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_mean under plus assimilation_strength is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lower assimilation strength reduces opinion shift magnitudes, increasing local absolute opinion variance and reducing global network connectivity.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Weaker assimilation leaves more absolute opinion spread inside neighborhoods, raising neighborhood absolute opinion variance; greater local variance can fragment the network, lowering the largest component fraction.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_largest_component_fraction under minus assimilation_strength is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Higher assimilation strength reduces local interaction distance variability and strengthens opinion-based edge similarity.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Stronger assimilation makes sampled interaction distances more uniform within neighborhoods, lowering interaction distance standard deviation; more homogeneous local ties increase network opinion assortativity.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_assortativity under plus assimilation_strength is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lower assimilation strength increases local absolute opinion dispersion and, under the initial distribution, lowers the global mean opinion.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Weaker assimilation allows absolute opinion values inside neighborhoods to remain spread out, raising neighborhood absolute opinion standard deviation; this increased dispersion shifts the whole-system mean downward relative to baseline.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_mean under minus assimilation_strength is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Raising the backfire threshold reduces repulsive encounters, lowering neighborhood opinion variance and therefore global variance.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Fewer backfire events mean less local opinion divergence, decreasing neighborhood opinion variance; lower local variance reduces whole-system opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under plus backfire_threshold is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lowering the backfire threshold increases repulsive encounters, raising local opinion dispersion and global variance.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: More backfire events push connected opinions apart, increasing neighborhood opinion standard deviation; greater local dispersion contributes to higher whole-system opinion variance.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_variance under minus backfire_threshold is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Raising the backfire threshold reduces repulsive encounters, lowering local interaction distance variance and supporting a larger connected component.

deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_largest_component_fraction under plus backfire_threshold is not higher than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lowering the backfire threshold increases repulsive encounters, raising local interaction distance variability and reducing opinion assortativity.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: More backfire events produce more variable sampled distances within neighborhoods, increasing neighborhood interaction distance standard deviation; more heterogeneous local ties weaken opinion-based edge similarity, lowering assortativity.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_assortativity under minus backfire_threshold is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Raising the backfire threshold reduces repulsive shift variability, which under the initial distribution lowers the global mean opinion.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: Fewer backfire events decrease the standard deviation of opinion shifts inside neighborhoods, lowering neighborhood agent shift standard deviation; reduced local shift variability shifts the whole-system mean opinion downward relative to baseline.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_opinion_global_mean under plus backfire_threshold is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

deffuant.scientific_rationale: Lowering the backfire threshold increases repulsive encounters, raising local absolute opinion dispersion and reducing opinion assortativity.
deffuant.mechanistic_explanation: More backfire events increase absolute opinion differences inside neighborhoods, raising neighborhood absolute opinion standard deviation; greater local absolute dispersion weakens edge-wise opinion similarity, lowering assortativity.
deffuant.falsification_condition: If macro_network_assortativity under minus backfire_threshold is not lower than baseline in the final 20 percent of steps, the path is falsified.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher tolerance increases the fraction of unsatisfied agents, which amplifies between-district differences in relocation activity and thereby raises the whole-system moved fraction.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: More unsatisfied agents attempt relocation, increasing district-level dispersion of moving fractions, and this dispersed local activation raises the global relocation fraction.
schelling.falsification_condition: Observed meso_district_move_fraction_std or macro_global_moved_fraction does not increase under tolerance plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher tolerance increases dissatisfaction, causing agents to move away from mixed-group boundaries; this reduces between-district boundary-fraction dispersion while strengthening whole-grid same-group neighbour similarity.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Stronger homophilic relocation removes boundary contacts and produces more homogeneous spatial sorting, lowering district boundary variation and raising global spatial similarity.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global spatial neighbour similarity does not increase under tolerance plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher tolerance intensifies segregation pressure, reducing district group-composition entropy and consolidating same-group areas into fewer contiguous components.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: As dissatisfaction rises, agents sort into more homogeneous districts, lowering group entropy and merging adjacent same-group clusters, which decreases the global connected-component count.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not decrease under tolerance plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower tolerance reduces the share of unsatisfied agents and district-level variation in dissatisfaction, while weaker sorting pressure allows spatial clusters to fragment into more same-group components.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Fewer agents are classified as unsatisfied, so between-district dissatisfaction dispersion falls, and less homophilic relocation prevents large cluster consolidation, increasing the number of same-group components.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not increase under tolerance minus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower tolerance reduces relocation pressure, lowering district-level moving-fraction dispersion and whole-grid spatial neighbour similarity as more mixed neighbourhoods persist.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: With fewer unsatisfied agents, relocation activity declines and becomes less spatially variable, weakening homophilic sorting and reducing global same-group adjacency.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global spatial neighbour similarity does not decrease under tolerance minus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher tolerance raises dissatisfaction, leading to more variable destination-similarity outcomes across districts while consolidating same-group areas into fewer connected components.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Stronger homophilic relocation increases between-district dispersion of destination similarity and merges adjacent same-group clusters, thereby decreasing the global component count.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not decrease under tolerance plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher move probability increases the realized relocation response among unsatisfied agents, amplifies cross-district dispersion in moving rates, and raises the global relocation fraction.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: More dissatisfied agents act on their dissatisfaction, creating greater district-level variability in movement and increasing whole-system relocation activity.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global moved fraction does not increase under move_probability plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher move probability increases relocation frequency, producing more variable destination-similarity outcomes across districts and raising global spatial neighbour similarity through repeated homophilic sorting.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: More moves allow more agents to enter high-similarity destinations, increasing district-level destination-similarity dispersion and whole-grid same-group adjacency.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global spatial neighbour similarity does not increase under move_probability plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower move probability weakens the relocation response of unsatisfied agents, increasing between-district dissatisfaction dispersion and raising the whole-system unsatisfied fraction because fewer agents escape poor local conditions.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: When unsatisfied agents are less likely to move, dissatisfaction persists unevenly across districts and globally, leading to higher global unsatisfied fraction.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global unhappy fraction does not increase under move_probability minus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower move probability reduces relocation frequency, allowing boundary contacts to persist unevenly across districts and preventing same-group cluster consolidation, which increases the number of spatial components.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Less movement preserves heterogeneous boundary patterns and spatial fragmentation, raising district boundary-fraction dispersion and global connected-component count.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not increase under move_probability minus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher move probability increases relocation frequency, producing greater between-district variation in local neighbour counts, but more movement resolves dissatisfaction and lowers the global unsatisfied fraction.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Relocation disperses agents and alters local occupancy, increasing district neighbour-count dispersion while moving more unsatisfied agents to acceptable neighbourhoods, thereby reducing global dissatisfaction.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global unhappy fraction does not decrease under move_probability plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher destination preference makes movers select more similar destinations, increasing average destination similarity and district-level destination-similarity dispersion, and raising whole-grid spatial neighbour similarity.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Selective relocation concentrates agents in high-similarity locations, increasing cross-district variation in destination quality and strengthening global segregation.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global spatial neighbour similarity does not increase under destination_preference plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher destination preference moves agents away from mixed boundaries, reducing boundary-fraction dispersion and lowering global dissatisfaction as more agents reach satisfying neighbourhoods.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Stronger preference for similar destinations removes agents from boundary contact and reduces the share of unsatisfied agents system-wide.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global unhappy fraction does not decrease under destination_preference plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Higher destination preference increases destination similarity, reduces district group-composition entropy, and consolidates same-group areas into fewer connected components.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Preferential homophilic moves create more homogeneous districts and merge adjacent same-group clusters, lowering both district entropy and global component count.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not decrease under destination_preference plus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower destination preference reduces average destination similarity and district-level destination-similarity dispersion, but less selective sorting leaves more agents unsatisfied globally.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Weaker preference lowers destination quality and spatial differentiation while preventing dissatisfied agents from reaching satisfying neighbourhoods, raising global dissatisfaction.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global unhappy fraction does not increase under destination_preference minus.

schelling.scientific_rationale: Lower destination preference produces less directed moves, increasing district-level dispersion of relocation distances and fragmenting spatial clusters, which raises the count of connected components.
schelling.mechanistic_explanation: Random destination choices lead to longer, more variable relocation distances and prevent same-group cluster consolidation, increasing the global component count.
schelling.falsification_condition: Macro global connected components does not increase under destination_preference minus.
